overview: The Medford Community Development Board continued a site plan and special permit review for 290 Salem Street and approved prior meeting minutes. Staff also provided an update on materials for the city's zoning overhaul.

items.title: 290 Salem Street Continuance
items.summary: The board voted to continue the site plan and special permit application for 290 Salem Street to May 15, 2024, pending revised plans.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the meeting minutes from March 20, 2024, and April 3, 2024.

items.title: Zoning Overhaul Updates
items.summary: Staff informed the board of emailed zoning overhaul materials and a City Council subcommittee presentation for members to review ahead of a future discussion.
